scope: All upstream registry-origin packages retained for the root workspace Cargo.lock, including ACP HTTP, default GUI/main executable, build dependencies, Rust test targets and optional workspace members. Packages repaired locally use the root [patch.crates-io] path overrides recorded in effective_source; all other registry packages resolve through the vendored-sources directory replacement. Target-specific and optional packages remain retained; graph presence does not claim every Windows feature or native path has been exercised.
source_copy_policy: The source and original_upstream_source strings, published crate archive URLs, archive_sha256 values and vcs records identify the original upstream releases. They remain unchanged for local repairs. Each effective_source identifies either the current registry identity (resolved through the vendored-sources replacement) or the root [patch.crates-io] local path identity. Local path entries intentionally have no registry source or checksum in Cargo.lock; the upstream archive digest is not a checksum of the repaired local tree. Local repairs are recorded in project_source_modifications: each global record identifies package, version and a files array identical to the package-level array; each file path is relative to the package directory and reason covers source, regression, documentation or inventory changes. The .cargo-checksum.json package field retains the original upstream archive digest, while file digests describe the current retained tree; local path dependencies are not immutable registry packages. Omitted upstream license texts remain separate under _upstream-licenses, with exact origin and digest. Effective identities are manifest/lock facts, not proof of production recompilation or runtime acceptance.
